{
  "phoneNote": "The swimming-themed identity is memorable, but oversized kickboard cards and repeated information make the mobile page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The bold kickboard composition establishes a strong identity and clear hierarchy, but the busy water background and repeated schedule compete with the main message.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 5,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Compress the mobile hero’s decorative space and replace the three tall information kickboards with a compact facts panel, bringing the training section much closer to the top.",
    "Show the schedule prominently once near the top; remove the duplicate hero badge and consolidate repeated time, location and age details across the facts, steps and FAQ sections.",
    "Reduce the contrast of the water background and remove secondary floating decorations so the headline and primary call action remain the strongest visual elements."
  ]
}
